_comment: The inside of the guard tower, a SEPARATE model from the tower rock with the SAME origin (guard-room floor = y 0): drop it into bentham_ring's Tower node at identity. Built from tools/modelling/tower_interior_build.py, which reads tower_new.blend every build (never writes it) to size the shaft: his shaft is SOLID rock below the room and is to be hollowed to this lining, which keeps >= 0.4 m of rock outside it at every height. Doorway at the courtyard (y -36.4) facing +X (game bearing 0), an arched passage through the rock to a porch on its face; a stone stair spiralling ccw up the wall (0.25 rise, 0.35 going, 1.2 wide, 0.9 parapet, landings every ~90 deg, a landing chamber near the waist, slot windows, drips) arriving through a 1.2 x 2.4 m stairwell hole in the room floor at the room's edge -- the tower room-floor collider must be cut there (the build log prints the hole's corners). One textured surface (painted HellRock atlas, byte-identical to the tower's), one UV set, no skin, no animation. TowerInteriorCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node (wall, floor, ceiling minus the throat, a smooth ramp under the treads -- a 0.25 m riser is a wall to the capsule -- parapets, soffit, doorway, chamber, kerb); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
